name: low_vol_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY's 5-minute realized vol is below 80% of its 20-minute baseline, institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms are executing patient directional orders rather than reacting to episodic news events. In this quiet regime, EMA alignment across 1-minute and 5-minute windows reflects sustained buy-side or sell-side absorption — not noise spikes. We enter in the EMA direction on a confirming 5-second bar and capture the next 45-90 second continuation of this institutional flow before vol re-expands.

indicators.name: rvol_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute realized vol — captures the current noise level at the same timescale as our hold horizon. The original used 20-day realized vol per stock; we scale to ~5 intraday minutes because the 'low-vol regime' exists at multiple timescales, and 5 min is the closest match to our 30-90s hold: enough bars for a stable estimate, recent enough to reflect the current market microstructure.

indicators.name: rvol_240
indicators.purpose: 20-minute baseline vol — the recent average against which we measure the current regime. 20 min captures the session's characteristic vol level without going stale, analogous to the original's 20-day cross-sectional baseline. Not scaled by 12x; instead chosen independently to represent a meaningful intraday baseline window.

indicators.name: vol_ratio
indicators.purpose: Relative vol indicator — when below 0.80, NIFTY is in a quiet regime where TWAP flows dominate over episodic news flows. Directly analogous to the original's bottom-tercile vol ranking (bottom third ≈ below 67th percentile of recent vol).

indicators.name: ema_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute fast EMA — captures the current 60-second trend direction. The original used EMA(9) on 1-min bars (9-min span); compressed to 1-min (12 bars at 5s) because our hold is 30-90s, not 60-240 min. Fast enough to detect real-time EMA crossovers that resolve within our trade window.

indicators.name: ema_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute slow EMA — trend context filter. Compresses from original's EMA(21) on 1-min (21-min span) to 5 min because our hold horizon is 30-90s; the slow EMA only needs to confirm intraday trend direction (bull/bear), not multi-hour drift.

conditions: ema_12 > ema_60 — bullish EMA alignment on 1-min vs 5-min
ret_1 > 0 — confirming 5-second bar in upward direction
buy_ce.confirmation: All three conditions true simultaneously within session window

conditions: ema_12 < ema_60 — bearish EMA alignment on 1-min vs 5-min
ret_1 < 0 — confirming 5-second bar in downward direction
buy_pe.confirmation: All three conditions true simultaneously within session window

exit.stop_rationale: In a low-vol regime, NIFTY typically moves 5-10 spot pts in 30-60s; a 3-option-pt loss (~6 spot pts at delta 0.5) means the quiet regime has broken and the directional thesis is invalid — the instantaneous vol has spiked past where TWAP dominates.
exit.target_rationale: Low-vol NIFTY momentum typically extends 10-15 spot pts within 60s; 5 option pts captures ~50% of that expected move, giving 1:1.67 risk-reward. Consistent with the 1-minute typical range of 3-7 pts from the calibration table.

filters.vix_filter: none — strategy uses internal vol_ratio as regime filter, which is more responsive than daily VIX
filters.time_filter: 09:30-15:20 IST; skip first 15 min of session to let overnight gap vol dissipate before applying low-vol regime test
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY index volume is structurally consistent intraday
filters.trend_filter: EMA alignment (ema_12 vs ema_60) acts as inline trend confirmation
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — TWAP/VWAP dominance in quiet vol regimes is a structural feature of institutional execution on NIFTY; unlikely to arbitrage away at 5-second resolution

adaptation_notes: The original cross-sectional strategy (rank NIFTY50 stocks by 20-day vol, long low-vol / short high-vol) is adapted to a single-index version by replacing cross-stock vol ranking with a NIFTY time-series vol regime test. Both capture the same phenomenon: in low-vol environments, systematic institutional flows dominate speculative flows and momentum signals become more reliable. Key changes: (1) 20-day cross-stock vol ranking replaced by 5-min vs 20-min rolling vol ratio on NIFTY spot; (2) 60-240 min hold compresses to 30-90 seconds; (3) pair trade structure eliminated — single direction entry (CE or PE) based on EMA alignment rather than long-short stock spread; (4) relative 30bps target replaced with absolute 5-pt option premium target.
weaknesses: Low-vol anomaly is primarily a multi-day cross-sectional effect; intraday single-index version may not capture the exact same institutional preference dynamics
In strongly trending sessions, vol_ratio may stay elevated above threshold for extended periods, reducing trade frequency
EMA crossover with confirming 5s bar may generate false signals at vol regime boundaries (just before vol expands from low to high)
